name: Suppression
description: Consent/suppression list: recipients or segments removed by unsubscribe/bounce/complaint

agentPrompts.label: Suppress an address or segment
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-campaigns` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then add the address (or whole segment) I name to the suppression list with the reason — unsubscribe, hard bounce, or complaint.

agentPrompts.label: Is this address suppressed?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-campaigns` skill in this folder, then check whether the address or segment I name is on the suppression list, and why, before it gets included in a send.
